infrastructure.provenance.code_revision..shutdown_contract: Synchronous Git probes use subprocess.run(capture_output=True, timeout=5), owning the child and captured pipes per attempt. Normal completion waits; subprocess.run timeout cleanup kills/waits according to the Python library. There is no detached backend here. Windows fallback attempts each have their own five-second timeout, not one global deadline. list_git_worktree_files passes an empty environment; existing metadata calls retain their default environment. Runtime cleanup/interrupt observations remain NOT_RUN_12553.
